statement: A uniform solid cylinder starts from rest and rolls without slipping down an 18 degree incline. Take g = 9.81 m/s^2. How long does it take to travel 3.4 m along the incline?
find: Time to roll 3.4 m from rest.
notes: a = (2/3) g sin(theta) for solid cylinder; t = sqrt(2d/a). a = 2.020971 m/s^2.
